text:
lina: Heads-up — SilverFern POC kickoff with ACME Health. They want to run a custom LLaMA-2-70B variant (fine-tuned) in a private deployment. Need catalog fit + enterprise security checks. Can we get compatibility + rough pricing estimate? :wave:
marco: @lina can you share the model artifacts or HF link? also expected QPS and max seq length? most 70B variants need quant + multi-gpu unless q4_0.
lina: Sent the s3 link in DM. Expecting ~30 r/s peak, 8k max seq, batch-friendly traffic. They may want KV cache reuse across requests.
anya: Pricing question — is customer okay with Dedicated reserved capacity or require Private (self-hosted) license? reserved capacity pricing differs. Lina — do they have committed spend?
lina: They're open to Dedicated monthly commit. Want cost/latency tradeoffs before signing. Also asked about per-token pricing vs flat reserved.
jordan: Security checklist — they need KMS integration, HSM optional, SOC2 evidence, VPC peering, retention controls, and a fillable security questionnaire. Also ask about e2e audit logs. :lock:
tariq: From runtime POV — for 70B + 8k seq: recommend q4f16/q4_0 variant and 2x A100-80GB or 4x A100/4090 with sharded KV cache. Continuous batching will help. If they insist on FP16, expect slotting into Dedicated multi-GPU pool.
tariq: Also, KV cache bandwidth estimate: with 8k tokens and 30 r/s, budget around ~1.2M kv-reads/s peak. We'll need to size GPU memory accordingly.
marco: Quick compatibility scan command I used for similar POCs:
```bash
ri model-scan --model s3://acme/silverfern-v1.tar.gz --target 'quant=q4f16,seq=8192' --report out.json
```
marco: I'll run that once I get the artifact access. Expected runtime warnings: rmsnorm mismatch, custom tokenizer > may need convert script.
jordan: For the security questionnaire: I'll prep answers for KMS, VPC, retention and link to SOC2 cert. Need a pointer to their legal contact.
lina: Contact is emily@acmehealth.com — looping her in on email after this sync. Also they asked about model explainability / ability to disable hallucinations — any eval hooks?
anya: We can run Redwood Optimize evals and set regression alerts tied to prompt sets — include that in proposal.
tariq: Blockers: artifact uses custom CUDA op in compile step — need to confirm we can build in Private deployment. If not, they must provide a CPU fallback. @marco can you flag if build required?
marco: noted. If custom ops present, we require a buildpack or a containerized runtime. That will move them to Private on-prem or Private cloud with build support.
lina: Next steps: @marco run scan by EOD, @jordan draft security answers by tomorrow, @anya prepare pricing sketch (Dedicated vs Private). I'll update ACME after we have results. Thanks all :thumbsup:

tariq: added — I'll follow up with hardware sizing doc after scan.
